topic_title: Winter Driving Hazards, Bridges & Black Ice
prompt: Why is engaging electronic cruise control dangerous when driving in freezing rain or icy road conditions?

options.text: Cruise control systems freeze solid and cannot be deactivated mechanically
Cruise control causes the vehicle radiator fluid to freeze at higher rates
Texas law makes cruise control a Class C misdemeanor in freezing weather
System can spin drive wheels if traction drops, causing instantaneous spinouts
